Yes — for a ~2-month (60-day) stay, you'll need a visa; Germany's visa-free allowance doesn't cover it.

- Germans get visa-free entry, but only for up to 45 days (unilateral exemption, currently extended through 2028-03-05). A 60-day trip exceeds that, so the free pathway doesn't apply.
- Recommended pathway: e-Visa. It covers stays up to 90 days, so your 60 days fits comfortably. Cost is USD 25 (single-entry) or USD 50 (multiple-entry), processing takes about 2-3 business days, and it's valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any approved port (no single-port restriction). Apply at evisa.gov.vn.
- Make sure your passport is valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

Data as of 2026-08-17 — double-check current policy at https://evisa.gov.vn/ before you travel, since exemption terms can change.
